tvShow.name: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
tvShow.overview: Mickey and pals welcome everyone back to the clubhouse for all-new adventures filled with songs, laughs, handy helping, and fun new surprises.

episodes.name: Mickey's Country Farm
episodes.overview: Mickey and friends use their new farm vehicles to build the Fairest Farm Fair ever — hoping Daisy’s cowgirl idol, Lasso Lucy, will stop by for a visit.

episodes.name: Mickey's New Helper
episodes.overview: Mickey and pals meet Little Helper, a handy helping friend. When it floats away in a glove balloon, they race to rescue it using their Mouseketools!

episodes.name: Clarabelle's New Coop
episodes.overview: When Clarabelle's coop is wrecked, Mickey and friends rebuild it using Mouseketools, giving her chickens a new, improved home!

episodes.name: Goofy's Sock Hunt
episodes.overview: Goofy's socks vanish during naps, and soon Mickey's stuff goes missing too! They find Pluto gathering items to build a cozy bed for a mama cat and her kittens.

episodes.name: Puppy Pluto
episodes.overview: Professor Von Drake's Itty Bitty Baby Ray turns him and Pluto into babies! Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to reverse the shrink ray.

guest_stars.character: Professor Von Drake / Baby Von Drake (voice)
guest_stars.name: Corey Burton

episodes.name: Goofy Pizza
episodes.overview: Goofy's hungry for pizza, but the fridge is missing ingredients. Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to gather what's needed and make a delicious pizza to share!

episodes.name: Minnie's Tune Train
episodes.overview: Professor Von Drake gifts a calliope car for the Clubhouse Choo-Choo train. Minnie performs a song, and she and Mickey help friends finish chores to join in.

episodes.name: Please the Bees
episodes.overview: Donald shakes a beehive, upsetting the bees. They buzz after him, but Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to build a new hive and calm them down.

episodes.name: Minnie's Dinner Party
episodes.overview: The pals help Minnie throw a dinner party for Clara Cluck. Using Mouseketools, they set the table, dress up in hats, and finish cooking before guests arrive.

episodes.name: Minnie's Backpack Adventure
episodes.overview: Minnie makes special backpacks, inspiring a hike to Goofy Rock. Using Mouseketools, they reach the top where Goofy climbs his namesake rock for a photo.

episodes.name: Mickey's Mail Mix-Up
episodes.overview: Dozens of letters and packages arrive at the Clubhouse by mistake. Mickey and Minnie find out that Von Drake's mail-sorting invention is broken.

guest_stars.character: Little Helper / Baby Elephant / Chicken / Voice Announcer (voice)
guest_stars.name: Dee Bradley Baker

episodes.name: Daisy Can’t Say
episodes.overview: Daisy's pals get tea to help her lost voice heal.

episodes.name: Minnie Mouse Clubhouse
episodes.overview: When the Clubhouse is busy, Minnie can't use the kitchen or Anywhere Areas. Mickey surprises her with her own pink Clubhouse, thanks to Von Drake's invention.

guest_stars.character: Baby Bear / Mama Bear / Baby Elephant / Little Helper (voice)
guest_stars.name: Dee Bradley Baker

episodes.name: The Ice Cream Mystery
episodes.overview: Go-Getters use gadgets to find the missing ice cream.

episodes.name: Say Cheese
episodes.overview: Mickey and pals take photos for a gallery wall.

episodes.name: Daisy's Hole in One Mystery
episodes.overview: Mouseketools help fix gopher holes.

episodes.name: Mickey and Pluto Go Camping
episodes.overview: Mickey's pals surprise him at Friendship Lake camp.

episodes.name: Martian Mickey's Clubhouse
episodes.overview: Mickey helps Martians build their own clubhouse.

episodes.name: Martian Mishap
episodes.overview: When Martian Mickey crash-lands on Earth, Mickey and pals help him repair his spaceship so he can safely return home.

episodes.name: Minnie's Rubber Ducky Doozy
episodes.overview: Minnie organises a rubber duck parade on the lake. When Goofy's duck goes missing, the Sensational Six dive into the water with Mouse Tools to find it.

episodes.name: SPOTS the Beagle-Bot
episodes.overview: Gang helps a robot dog learn to play with Pluto.

episodes.name: Mickey's Movie Night
episodes.overview: Mickey and pals help Pete at his movie theater.

episodes.name: Clubhouse Carnival
episodes.overview: Mickey and pals search for Donald's lost toy lion.

episodes.name: Tale of the Moo-Maids
episodes.overview: The pals dive to find Daisy's pearls with Sea Queen.

episodes.name: Daisylocks and the Three Bears
episodes.overview: Mickey guides Daisylocks home.

episodes.name: A Dragon Tale
episodes.overview: A tea party is disrupted by a dragon.

episodes.name: The Late, Late Show
episodes.overview: The pals try to stay awake for the meteor shower.

episodes.name: Donald's Clubhouse Sleepover
episodes.overview: Mickey and pals help Donald get a good night's sleep.

episodes.name: The Candy Cottage
episodes.overview: Pals gather candy to fix Wizard Pete's candy cottage.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Mickey and his pals welcome everyone back to the clubhouse they know and love for all-new adventures filled with games, songs, laughs, and of course, handy helping. Devoted fans will also find surprises in store for them, including a new upper level called the Laughing Loft, Minnie, Donald, Daisy, and Goofy get their very own clubhouses, and an adorable new friend Little Helper. Mickey's trusted magical teddy bear, Duffy the Disney Bear, even makes an official appearance. Beloved by preschoolers and their families around the world, the series will combine the rich heritage of Disney's classic characters with state-of-the-art CG animation and will introduce a whole new generation of Mickey and the wonders that await them inside the clubhouse, with the new Wacky Tube, a funny new way to travel around the clubhouse. Donald, Daisy, Goofy, and Minnie will all get their own personalized clubhouses as the series goes on.
